entries.source: RIplus Regg. Pfalzgrafen 1 n. 4741: Karlsr. Copb. 465,101 (in die innoc.).
entries.german: Ruprecht belehnt Else von Erlekeim, wittwe Eberhards von Rosenberg, an ihrer unmündigen söhne statt, mit Boxberg halb und andern lehengütern.
entries.english: Ruprecht enfeoffed Elisabeth von Erligheim, widow of Eberhard von Rosenberg, in place of her underage son, with half of Boxberg and other fiefdoms.
facts: Elisabeth von Erligheim received half of Boxberg and other feudal goods on behalf of her minor sons
[vogt_zu_Lauda] had minor sons with Elisabeth von Erligheim
Ruprecht granted fiefs to Elisabeth von Erligheim as guardian of her minor sons
